blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — Scrap buyers who purchase stolen government property and private utility companies’ equipment could face fines if a proposed ordinance in Mandaue City gets approved. The Mandaue City Council passed the proposed ordinance upon first reading during their regular session on Monday, November 16. City Councilor Jennifer Del Mar said that her proposal is meant to hold scrap buyers accountable for purchasing stolen items, particularly when the materials clearly belong to the government or private utility companies.
